_comment: The ONLY programs the action plan may recommend. Claude picks from this list and writes the 'why' line; titles, buttons and links always come from here. Before the demo, check every entry and set 'verified' to true. Replace each top-level URL with the exact program page.

programs.title: Find your nearest cooling center
programs.default_why: On heat emergency days, cooling centers give you a safe, cool place to go.

why_if.heat_high: Your block stays hot into the night. Cooling centers open on heat emergency days.

programs.title: Request a free street tree
programs.default_why: Trees shade about {canopy_pct}% of your block. Boston plants street trees for free when residents ask.

why_if.trees_low: Trees shade only about {canopy_pct}% of your block. Boston plants street trees for free when residents ask.

programs.title: Join community solar and save on your bill
programs.default_why: No roof needed. Renters can sign up and get a credit on their electric bill.

programs.title: Sign up for heat alerts
programs.default_why: Get a text when Boston declares a heat emergency, so you can plan ahead.

programs.title: Get a heat pump with AC
programs.default_why: Cools your whole home on hot nights and heats it in winter, too.

programs.title: Switch to a cool roof
programs.default_why: Your roof looks dark in aerial photos. A light roof reflects sun and keeps top floors cooler.

programs.title: Plant trees on your property
programs.default_why: Shade on the south and west sides of your home cools it the most.

programs.title: Add rooftop solar
programs.default_why: Make your own power and lower your electric bill. Your roof's sun score is coming soon.
